after_notes: Exact-package Ultra 205 attempt-002 proves one post-boot station disconnect, immediate AP fallback, first retry after the configured 5,000-ms delay, same-boot DHCP recovery, retry reset, client-only restoration, 15,000-ms stability, final same-origin HTTP/build quorum, disabled mining/control, cleanup, private modes, independent validation, and redaction; see docs/parity/work-plans/20260812T034058Z-NET-001/RESULT.md and docs/parity/evidence/net001-reconnect/network-reconnect-projection.json. Repeated/long-running reconnects, provisioning-client suppression, IPv6, router/RF failures, other boards, mining, hardware control, updates, recovery, and release readiness remain non-claims. Later evidence, outside the projection above, adds Wi-Fi modem power save off as upstream sets it: `reference/esp-miner/components/connect/connect.c` calls `esp_wifi_set_ps(WIFI_PS_NONE)` in both of its branches, and `firmware/bitaxe/src/wifi_adapter.rs` now sets it after each driver start, before any association, confirmed on hardware by the retained line `wifi_power_save=none`. Before it, local mining soaks met six outages in about 9.1 hours, one logged as a `beacon_timeout` station disconnect. With it, exact-package Ultra 205 soak 004 attempt 002 (2 hours) and soak 005 (8 hours) met one `beacon_timeout` in about 10 hours; the station reconnected in about 10 s on the same boot and local mining recovered; see docs/parity/evidence/20261019-ultra205-handover-loop-and-wifi-power-save.md and docs/parity/evidence/20261020-ultra205-local-mining-soak-005.md. This narrows the long-running reconnect non-claim to markedly fewer disconnects, each recovered, over 10 hours; the cause of the remaining disconnect, router/RF failures, and the remaining non-claims above still apply.
